items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类，且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。

items.source: messages - The list of messages in the chat. This can be used to keep a chat memory.
items.translation: messages - 聊天中的消息列表。可用于保存聊天记录。

items.source: stream - Whether to stream the response. If false, the response will be returned as a single response object rather than a stream of objects.
items.translation: stream - 是否流式传输响应。如果为 false，响应将作为单个响应对象返回，而不是对象流。

items.source: format - The format to return the response in. It can either be the String "json" or a Map containing a JSON Schema definition.
items.translation: format - 指定返回响应的格式。可以是字符串 "json"，或包含 JSON Schema 定义的 Map。

items.source: keepAlive - Controls how long the model will stay loaded into memory following this request (default: 5m).
items.translation: keepAlive - 控制模型在请求后保留在内存中的时长（默认：5 分钟）。

items.source: tools - List of tools the model has access to.
items.translation: tools - 模型可访问的工具列表。

items.source: options - Model-specific options. For example, "temperature" can be set through this field, if the model supports it.
items.translation: options - 模型特定的选项。例如，如果模型支持，可以通过此字段设置“temperature”。
